_meta.description: Canonical navigation layout applied AFTER all manifest.d fragments merge (see applyMenuRelocations in main.js). Fragments stay the source of WHAT exists in the menu (ADR-037); this file is the single place deciding WHERE entries live. relocations: sourceId -> targetGroupId (groups dissolve into the target, leaves move under it, a child group targeting its own parent flattens). removals: leaf menu-entry ids retired as duplicate navigation — their PAGES stay routable for deep links and e2e specs. Lives outside manifest.json because the app-manifest-v2 schema has additionalProperties:false at the root.
